verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring browser-automation jobs is a fair question for a cloud agent platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents one-off run creation (client.runs.create), sessions that group several runs, and event polling. Nothing shows a built-in scheduler, cron, or recurring trigger, and a one-off action is not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
